OCR runs in the visitor browser; uploaded screenshots are not sent to a service.

Vendored upstream packages (unchanged):
- tesseract.js 6.0.1, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract.js-core 6.0.0, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, MIT package license, English LSTM integer model from 4.0.0_best_int, https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

Registry sources:
https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js/-/tesseract.js-6.0.1.tgz
https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js-core/-/tesseract.js-core-6.0.0.tgz
https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/eng/-/eng-1.0.0.tgz

Core wrapper .wasm.js files contain the WebAssembly binary; no external .wasm fetch is required.
The worker picks the SIMD LSTM wrapper when the browser supports it, otherwise the standard LSTM wrapper.
Only the selected wrapper is loaded per OCR run.
